items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Sonny didn't show up... they was out looking for a drummer... I made a session with Basie

ctx.x: Sonny Payne. And they made a record date and I went down and made a session. And not that day but about, I'd say, about a month later I made a session with Basie because something happened. Sonny didn't show up, and I don't know what happened, but he wasn't there. And they was out looking for a drummer, and I just happened to be walking down Broadway, and the valet saw me and said, "Good, just the guy I want to see." And went by Columbia Studio and -- yeah, Columbia Studio.
